Without networks listed, the app tries the home address first whenever it is on Wi-Fi. Adding your home networks picks the address faster. Reading the network name requires location permission and location turned on.

When several devices hear the wake word, they coordinate, and only the one that heard you best answers. With a single device, nothing changes.
How this device appears on the others
Paused: another app is using the microphone (for example another assistant with a wake word).
Tap to talk to the assistant.
Tap to start listening for the wake word.
You can create a wake word of your choice, in any language, with the free openWakeWord training notebook on Google Colab. It takes about an hour and needs no programming.
Open the training notebook (button below) and sign in with a Google account.
Enter your wake word in the target word field. Use English letters (see the tips below).
Run the cell that generates sample audio and listen to it. If it does not sound like your word, change the spelling and try again.
Run the remaining cells to train the model. When it finishes, download the .tflite file.
Copy the file to this device, then tap \"Import model…\" in settings and give it a name.
Tips for words that are not English
Spell the word phonetically in English letters, the way an English speaker would read it.
Avoid sounds English lacks (for example a guttural ch or r). Choose a word that sounds similar without them.
Prefer 3 to 4 syllables. Short words cause more false triggers.
Always listen to the generated samples before the full training run.

Waiting to be added in HA
Turn on wake word listening so HA can connect
Not discovered? In HA add the ESPHome integration with the address %1$s.
In HA: Settings › Devices and services › Discovered › Add, and paste the key.
HA is not connected to this device. Add it in HA (Settings › Devices and services), or check that both are on the same network.
A clock, the date and (soon) the weather, for a device that stays in one place. Use it as the system screen saver, or open it yourself.
In the screen saver settings choose \"Bayit Voice clock\" and when to start it (for example while charging).

For phones whose system has no screen saver (Realme, Oppo and others). Opens when the charger is connected, and again if the screen times out while charging; closes when unplugged. Needs listening (wake word or satellite) to be on.

While it plays, the idle screen shows what is playing with play/pause, next and volume. The controls need the same \"Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions\" option. Album art needs the HA address in the direct-mode settings.

The HA weather entity to show (satellite link). For today\'s high and low, turn on \"Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions\" for this device in HA (Settings › Devices and services › ESPHome › Configure).
At night only a dim red clock is shown. Use the same time for both to turn night mode off.
Screen off (the wake word, a timer or an announcement still turns it on)

Off: the idle screen follows the phone\'s brightness, including auto-brightness. It changes gradually over a few minutes between day and night, and only while the idle screen is showing; the phone\'s own setting is never changed.
